reviewScope: Read-only independent review of product UI interactions, owned presentation CSS, frozen source/evidence consistency, and recorded screenshots. No source edits, rebuilds, repeated broad tests, or external deployment.
resolvedFindings: Captured source-version warning persists independently of sample rendering.
Open review count excludes reviewed and dismissed accepted results.
Keyed history controls preserve identity during polling; selected-result responses are guarded by run identity and selection epoch.
Single-flight polling avoids timer-induced request starvation; successful queue/review/cancel invalidates list reads started before the mutation.
Failed-result state retains an explicit retry; image events are guarded by sample epoch; matching result-request finalizer owns loading cleanup.
Queue, review, cancellation, registration and rename retain explicit command identity for same-intent response retries.
Pending mutation actions prevent duplicates; unchanged-name rename is disabled; review focus restoration does not steal newer focus.
Accessible frame alternatives, textual observations, unique run/rename names, native disclosures, and live sample/status text are present.
Image height constraints that could misalign overlays were removed; zero-detection message no longer occupies the detection score column.
Product layout presents media and review before history in narrow DOM flow, with reviewed desktop CSS placement.

nonBlockingFindings.description: The .content:has(.workspace > .veyviz-analysis) selectors expect nesting, while the maintained shell adds the analysis class to div.workspace itself. Intended analysis-specific width/padding overrides do not match.
nonBlockingFindings.impact: Shared product content rules still style the workspace, and recorded browser geometry reports no horizontal overflow or lost controls.
nonBlockingFindings.suggestedFollowup: Use a selector matching the actual .workspace.veyviz-analysis element when next changing presentation CSS.

build.observed: Successful assembly of all six products including both Veyviz variants.

observedVisuals: Desktop screenshot shows selected real sample, run history, observations, and review actions together.
Narrow screenshot shows media before review and history; right edge is clipped by screenshot capture, as disclosed in the browser report.
No fake playback, live-camera status, positive detections, or empty-site assurance appears in the inspected screenshots.
browser.supportedJourney: Register/rename; actual six- and three-frame inference; sample and keyboard navigation; review/dismiss persistence; retained source-change warning; cancellation; tenant separation; viewer read-only presentation; scoped desktop/tablet/phone geometry.
browser.qualificationLimit: This reviewer inspected the report and actual screenshots, not an independently repeated interactive browser run. Reported DOM geometry supports no-overflow claims; the clipped narrow screenshot alone does not prove them.

fileVerification.limitation: File verification alone does not establish behavior or accuracy.

fullSuite.note: Completed session 96431 exit 0 was reported by root; the independent reviewer read the completed TAP log and exact counts. Test 101 is explicitly SKIP/BLOCKED_ENV because Windows denied creation of the owned file-symlink fixture with EPERM. This required gate is not qualified; no host security setting was changed.

readinessAssessment: The evidence supports a substantially improved, usable local sampled-video review experience on the selected recorded fixture. It does not justify a world-class, bug-free, universally ready, detection-accurate, or production-qualified claim.
qualificationLimits: Only the admitted local MIVIA recording and RF-DETR CPU profile are covered.
Actual fixture outputs are zero detections; positive-detection overlay rendering, detection quality, and occupancy are not qualified by these browser journeys.
No exhaustive browser/network-fault matrix, full 25-row stress test, screen-reader study, formal WCAG audit, or representative user evaluation was performed.
Uploads, live cameras, continuous video playback, native mobile, external identity and production deployment remain outside the qualified profile.
Observed logs, reports, and screenshots are recorded execution evidence, not cryptographic execution attestation.
